entities.summary: St. Lawrence's Chapel is a Roman Catholic chapel located on the peak of Sněžka mountain of the Giant Mountains in Poland. The chapel is located around 5 kilometres (3 mi) west of the centre of Karpacz, next to the Czech–Polish state border.
